subject: Aurorafin SOC2/SIG: KMS geo-segmentation, emergency key-eviction & rotation runbook
messages:
From: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@aurorafin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@aurorafin.com>, procurement@aurorafin.com
Date: Tue, 4 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/SIG evidence request: KMS geo-segmentation + emergency eviction

Hi Markus,

As part of Aurorafin's SOC2 readiness work and concurrent SIG review, our security team needs a compact evidence package covering Redwood's key management controls. We are specifically focused on three items where we need clarity and artifacts:

1) Geo-segmentation of encryption keys: a short architecture diagram showing how keys are partitioned/segmented by region/tenant and any controls that prevent cross-region key access.

2) Emergency key-eviction (escape) / recentering playbook: documented steps your ops team follows when we request an emergency eviction or when a region is compromised (what is the RTO, who signs off, and sample audit trail).

3) Rotation runbook and a timestamped sample of a rotation event (logs or CSV) covering both HSM-backed and KMS-managed rotations in the last 90 days.

We'd appreciate the artifacts as PDF/DOCX and a short note on whether you can provide a signed attestation (DocuSign or signed PDF) that the artifacts are accurate for our audit pack.

Would you be able to deliver the items by EOD PDT Thursday (2028-07-06)? If not, please propose a short timeline.

Thanks,
Anika
Anika Sharma
Security Lead, Aurorafin
anika.sharma@aurorafin.com

[This message may be part of our SOC2 intake - please confirm receipt and point us to a single contact for follow-ups.]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@aurorafin.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: KMS geo-segmentation + emergency eviction

Thanks Anika — got it. Marking this priority.

Kimberly and Marissa, can you own collection and delivery for Aurorafin? Key asks: geo-seg diagram, eviction playbook, rotation runbook + a timestamped sample. Please include HSM attestation details and an operator-access matrix.

Plan:
- Kimberley: produce the geo-seg diagram and eviction playbook draft
- Marissa: extract the rotation event sample and the operator access matrix; coordinate the attestation workflow

Anika — we'll aim to deliver the first pass of artifacts and a proposed attestation option by EOD Thursday. If we need an extra day for signed paperwork, we'll flag it by Wednesday EOD.

Markus Klein
Head of Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0134

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: KMS geo-segmentation + emergency eviction

Hi Anika — attaching the first set of artifacts for your review. Quick notes below.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood-kms-geoseg-diagram.pdf 
  - Shows regional key partitioning (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1), tenant scoping, and the smart-routing guardrail that prevents KC (key consumption) across region boundaries.

- keystore-eviction-playbook.pdf 
  - The emergency eviction playbook covers: detection & triage, immediate key disablement steps (HSM policy enforcement), traffic reroute, and operator sign-off flow. RTO target is 30 minutes for a single key eviction; full rekeying across an affected region is scoped at 4 hours in Runbook v2.

- rotation-runbook-v2.docx 
  - Daily/weekly/monthly rotation policies, HSM-backed rotation ceremony notes (split-key ceremony for high-sensitivity tenants), and automated rotation triggers for token/short-lived keys.

- rotation-event-sample-20280701.csv 
  - Redacted, timestamped sample showing a rotation carried out 2028-07-01T02:14:26Z. Columns: event_time, key_id, operator_id, action, old_kek_hash, new_kek_hash, signer.

We include a short exported sample of operator audit logs in the CSV. If you need raw log ingestion (S3 link) or additional filters (by tenant id), let us know the exact scope and we'll prepare.

Attestation: we can provide a signed PDF attestation. We typically issue attestation after contract/PO triggers or via our standard DocuSign flow. If Aurorafin needs a pre-signed statement for SOC2 planning, we can produce an un-signed draft attestation today and sign once procurement confirms the mechanism.

Next steps: confirm that the attachments are sufficient or request specific additional log slices.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

[Attachments: redwood-kms-geoseg-diagram.pdf, keystore-eviction-playbook.pdf, rotation-runbook-v2.docx, rotation-event-sample-20280701.csv]

From: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@aurorafin.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@aurorafin.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jul 2028 17:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request: KMS geo-segmentation + emergency eviction

Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround, this looks promising. A couple of follow-ups from the SOC2 team: 

- Can you provide the rotation_event CSV with full timestamps in UTC and include the rotation transaction IDs? The sample is fine, but auditors want the full tx ids for traceability.
- For the eviction playbook, auditors want an example of a signed operator action (a signed transaction/excerpt). If you can provide a redacted signed operator transcript for the 2028-07-01 event, that would be ideal.
- For attestation: can you create a DocuSign envelope and include the statement that the artifacts are accurate as of 2028-07-05? Procurement will coordinate acceptance.

If you can get the CSV with tx IDs and the redacted operator signature by EOD Wednesday (2028-07-05) we should be aligned for our evidence bundle.

Anika

[Note: we will add this to our CAIQ/SIG packet and may follow up with a short technical call to verify the geoseg model.]
